## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与最终行为

Explain the concrete change, why it helps authors and any compatibility impact.

## Verification / 实际测试

List exact commands and results. Separate LOCAL, MOCK, headless/browser, native desktop and REAL AI. Mark tests not run; do not imply cloud CI ran locally.

## Data format and safety / 用户数据

- Does this change user data formats, migrations, save/undo or backup behavior? If yes, describe rollback and explicit approval requirements.
- [ ] No private prose, API keys, credentials, personal paths or unsanitized logs.
- [ ] Existing project scope, Writer isolation and author confirmation remain enforced.
- [ ] Existing projects and retained releases remain compatible, or the limitation is explicit.

## Dependencies, assets and licensing

- [ ] New dependencies/assets list their actual version, source, license and distribution conditions.
- [ ] No private model/voice/plugin cache is redistributed.

The project license/copyright identity remains subject to the owner's confirmation. Do not invent a maintainer contact; consult SECURITY.md for private disclosure setup.
